text: Implemented mode-specific synchronization cardinality: one common mark proves offset-only, affine still requires two; residual summaries and uncertainty now use non-negative SyncErrorMagnitude, residual/rejection constructors are coherent and private. OccupancyResult construction is private behind validated recording support. Sample-origin evidence now reports overlapping compositional lineage counts with sampleCount/derived counts; tidy schema bumped to eyes4s-tidy-aoi/2. Split TidyCsv.parseRaw from TidyCsv.decode; decoded documents validate scalar/unit semantics, finite frame bits/bounds/axis, native and analysis clocks plus synchronization marks/residual diagnostics, detector card identity/version/citations/assumptions/deviations/references/config, non-negative timing and lineage counts, provenance structure, and lowercase SHA-256. PsychologyWorkflowReport now names sourceRows/acceptedRows/rejectedRows; result exposes warnings and provenance directly. Mutation proof: forcing offset-only back to two marks failed the one-mark test; accepting negative SyncErrorMagnitude failed residual tests; public OccupancyResult construction failed the compile-time boundary test; bypassing SHA validation failed the raw-vs-scientific decoder test; latest-only lineage counting failed transformed-evidence tests. Final regressions: kernel JVM/JS 157/157, core JVM/JS 76/76, io JVM/JS 21/21, laws JVM 225 and JS 222. No publication performed.
